exercise.title: 6ths, 7ths or octave?
exercise.why: The major 7th stops a half step short of the high Do and the minor 7th a whole step short, so you can tell them apart by how far each is from the octave.

cells.text: Press Start below. The game plays Do and then a note a 6th, a 7th or an octave above it. Hum the second note back, then pick its name: m7 for the minor 7th, M7 for the major 7th, P8 for the octave.
